view: PA frontal chest radiograph (erect), "L" side marker at image right confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration (approx. 9-10 posterior ribs visible), minimal rotation, adequate penetration with thoracic spine faintly visible through the heart, both costophrenic angles and lung apices included; scapulae partly projected over the lateral upper lung fields, more on the left.

devices.type: External radiographic side marker (L) with adjacent round radiopaque external marker disc
devices.location: Patient's left shoulder / left supraclavicular soft tissue, outside the thoracic cavity

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），吸氣量足夠、旋轉輕微，影像品質尚可；左肩外側見「L」側別標記及一圓形不透光外部標記物，位於胸腔外，非體內裝置，未見胸管、引流管或心律調節器。雙側肺野清晰，各區未見實質化、結節、腫塊或氣胸，肺紋理分布正常，雙側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液。心臟大小正常（心胸比<0.5），縱膈與氣管居中，主動脈結輪廓正常，左橫膈下可見胃泡。骨骼（肋骨、鎖骨、胸椎、肩胛骨）及軟組織未見明顯異常，整體為正常胸部X光。
